title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site update
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Motivation: Provide opinionated quickstarts and template examples for RAG agents that demonstrate tool-calling patterns (HTTP APIs, search tools, and external function calls) in both TypeScript and Python. This lowers time-to-value for developers integrating agents with real-world tools and ensures docs coverage for tool-calling best practices.

Summary of changes: added two new quickstarts (TS + Python), example templates (email-assistant, calendar-scheduler), updated docs site to include a new Agents -> Tool calling section, and added integration tests and CI docs build updates. The description below includes the checklist and testing notes.

What this PR does: 
- examples/rag-agent/quickstarts/ts-tool-calling: TypeScript quickstart with Redwood SDK example, local server snippet, and step-by-step runbook.
- examples/rag-agent/quickstarts/python-tool-calling: Python quickstart with redwood-sdk-python, virtualenv instructions and sample handler.
- examples/rag-agent/templates/email-assistant.yaml, calendar-scheduler.yaml: two opinionated RAG templates demonstrating multi-tool orchestration and KV cache hints.
- docs/docs/agents/tool-calling.md: new docs page describing architecture, security notes, model compatibility, and rate limiting considerations.
- website/src/components/QuickstartCard.tsx: UI card to surface the new quickstarts on the docs homepage.
- tests/examples/rag-agent/test_integration.py: integration test that exercises a mocked tool endpoint and verifies expected agent actions.
- scripts/generate-docs-index.sh: index generation tweaked to pick up new docs nav entry.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add TS quickstart and sample code
- [x] Add Python quickstart and sample code
- [x] Add templates and example config
- [x] Update docs site navigation and add tool-calling page
- [x] Add integration test for tool-calling pattern (mocked endpoint)
- [x] Lint and unit tests pass
- [x] Docs build passes in CI
- [x] Add release notes entry

Testing:
- Ran local examples and verified end-to-end flows against mocked tools.
- Integration test added and passes in CI (with flaky isolation).
- Docs site builds locally using yarn build and deployed to staging docs site for visual verification.

Notes and migration:
- No breaking changes to public APIs. The quickstarts reference existing SDK methods; minor call signatures are the same.
- Security: docs include KMS/HMAC guidance for tool credentials and a note to rotate tokens frequently.

Follow-ups (tracked in ENG-2245):
- Add a video walkthrough for the TS quickstart,
- Add more sample templates for enterprise data connectors,
- Add a canary test that runs the quickstart against Dedicated staging.

References: Linear ENG-2245, DOCS-118.
commits: Add TS tool-calling quickstart and README
Add Python quickstart and sample handler
Docs: add agents/tool-calling.md and nav entry
Tests: integration test for mocked tool endpoint
Fix lint and CI issues, update docs index script
review_comments: Priya Desai (request changes): Please add a short section in the docs about model compatibility and token limits for multi-tool flows—we saw confusion during the last support case.
Aisha Patel (author): Added a 'Model compatibility & token budgeting' subsection in docs and called it out in the quickstarts. Also added a token-budget example in the TS README.
Evan Miller (comment): Integration test intermittently failed in CI due to timing of mocked tool. Can we increase the timeout or make the mock deterministic?
Aisha Patel (author): Increased mock server timeout and added deterministic response ordering; re-ran CI and the test passed consistently.
Liam O'Connor (approval): LGTM. Clean docs and examples, tests look good. Happy to merge after CI is green.
release_notes: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts (TypeScript and Python), two example templates, docs site tool-calling guide, and integration tests. No breaking changes.
